# ox402

57 capability APIs an AI agent can't run in its own sandbox, paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base).
Base URL: https://satisfaction-genetic-lightbox-buying.trycloudflare.com

- No free trial: every call settles in USDC via x402 (Standard 402 handshake + X-PAYMENT header).
- Neural TTS via Kokoro-82M ($0.004 / 1k chars, 30+ English voices, fully offline on CPU).
- Video/audio billed per started minute (~$0.0004/min), no file-size cap.
- Browser captures (full-page screenshots/PDF) run in an isolated, throwaway Chromium profile; private/loopback addresses blocked.
- MCP server (streamable HTTP): https://satisfaction-genetic-lightbox-buying.trycloudflare.com/mcp402/  (compact tool list ~1.6k tokens; verbose schemas on demand)
- Catalog JSON: https://satisfaction-genetic-lightbox-buying.trycloudflare.com/x402/catalog

## Tools

- tts-voices ($0.0000) - List available Kokoro neural voices (af_*/am_* = US English, bf_*/bm_* = UK English). Free reference call.
- stt-fast ($0.0020) - Fast local speech-to-text (whisper-tiny): cheap transcript for clear audio. Billed $0.002 per started minute. Free trial caps at 5 min/file. Less accurate than stt.
- image-compress ($0.0020) - Cheap image shrink: resize to a max dimension + quality, returns smaller base64. For trimming payloads before you send them on. Returns saved %.
- tts ($0.0040) - Neural text-to-speech via Kokoro-82M (real neural TTS, 30+ English voices, runs offline on CPU). WAV base64. Billed $0.004 per 1k chars (<=4000 chars/call). Falls back to espeak-ng if model unavailable. Voices via tts-voices.
- video-download ($0.0040) - Direct download links for any video URL (yt-dlp, 1000+ platforms). Priced per-minute of the source (~$0.0004/min) — reports source duration. No file-size cap.
- crypto-price ($0.0040) - Crypto spot prices + 24h change (CoinGecko ids). Read-only.
- fx-rates ($0.0040) - Fiat FX rates (ECB daily reference). Read-only.
- weather ($0.0040) - Current weather + 3-day forecast by city or coords. Read-only.
- video2mp3 ($0.0040) - Video/audio URL -> clean mono MP3 (48kbps, yt-dlp + ffmpeg, 1000+ platforms). Billed per started minute at $0.0004/min, reports minutes_billed. No file-size cap. Platform blocks may apply (YouTube/Vimeo need auth).
- http-headers ($0.0040) - HTTP response status + full headers for a URL. Read-only.
- dns-lookup ($0.0050) - DNS records A/AAAA/MX/NS/TXT/CNAME for a domain. Read-only.
- stock-quote ($0.0050) - Stock quote: last price, prev close, exchange (Yahoo Finance). Read-only.
- geoip ($0.0050) - IP geolocation: country/city/ISP/proxy/hosting flags. Read-only.
- temp-webhook ($0.0050) - Ephemeral public webhook URL (1h TTL): POST anything to it, then poll the same URL to read payloads. No server needed.
- robots ($0.0050) - Fetch robots.txt and return structured allow/disallow rules.
- stt ($0.0060) - Speech-to-text via Whisper-large-v3: timestamped transcript from audio URL/base64. Billed $0.006 per started minute. Free trial caps at 5 min/file; paid allows 25MB/file up to 120 min. Premium accuracy.
- ssl-check ($0.0060) - TLS certificate validity, expiry (days), issuer, SANs for a host:443. Read-only.
- sitemap ($0.0060) - Fetch + parse a sitemap.xml, list URLs (and nested maps).
- cookie-flags ($0.0060) - Parse Set-Cookie for Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite flags; list insecure or JS-readable cookies.
- reverse-dns ($0.0060) - Reverse DNS: IP -> PTR hostname. Confirms what a server calls itself.
- web-archive ($0.0060) - Fetch the latest Wayback Machine snapshot for any URL. Recover changed/dead pages.
- search ($0.0080) - Read-only web search (DuckDuckGo): title+url+snippet per result. Cost $0.008/call.
- html2md ($0.0080) - Extracts clean Markdown from any public URL (no raw DOM noise). Read-only.
- video-info ($0.0080) - Video metadata + all stream formats (YouTube/TikTok/Vimeo/X/1000+ sites) via yt-dlp. Read-only.
- md-compress ($0.0080) - Compress scraped/markdown text for prompts: strips base64 blobs, tracking pixels, dup lines, whitespace runs. Typically 30-50% smaller.
- cors-check ($0.0080) - Probe a URL CORS policy from a fake origin: detect wildcard/credentialed cross-origin holes.
- dns-recon ($0.0080) - Full DNS recon: A/AAAA/MX/NS/TXT/CNAME/SOA + SPF/DKIM/DMARC email-auth presence.
- web-scrape ($0.0100) - Server-side URL scrape returning title + readable text. Use when you need plain text fast. Read-only.
- whois ($0.0100) - Domain WHOIS: registrar, creation/expiry dates, nameservers, availability. Read-only.
- image-optimize ($0.0100) - Convert heic/png/jpeg -> webp/jpeg/png with compression + optional max_width resize. Reports saved %.
- link-scan ($0.0100) - URL safety scan: full redirect chain, tracking-param strip, urlhaus+openphish feeds, SSL validity, phishing-form heuristic, risk score.
- security-headers ($0.0100) - Grade a sites HTTP security headers (HSTS/CSP/X-Frame-Options/XXP/Referrer-Policy/Permissions-Policy). A-D grade.
- port-scan ($0.0100) - TCP connect scan of common ports (honest: one datacenter vantage, not stealth).
- leak-check ($0.0100) - Email against HaveIBeenPwned k-anonymity range API: breached? how many times?
- subdomain-find ($0.0100) - Passive subdomain discovery via crt.sh certificate transparency (no probing).
- threat-intel ($0.0100) - IP reputation: DNSBL blacklist hits + proxy/VPN/Tor + geo (ipwho.is). Verdict clean/suspicious.
- email-verify ($0.0100) - Email deliverability check: syntax + MX record presence + disposable-domain flag. DNS only, no send.
- header-compare ($0.0100) - Compare security headers of two sites side by side (HSTS/CSP/XFO/XXP/RP/PP). Migration + audit aid.
- trend-watch ($0.0100) - Recent signal volume on a keyword across news/social slices. Early-trend radar.
- deep-search ($0.0120) - Multi-query fan-out search: dedupe + rank results across 5 queries. Agent-grade discovery.
- fact-check ($0.0120) - Claim -> search corroborating/contradicting sources, return verdict (corroborated/contradicted/mixed).
- repo2context ($0.0150) - GitHub repo -> single LLM-ready context file: clones, strips lockfiles/binaries/minified, packs source into markdown. Size-capped.
- citations ($0.0150) - Fetch N URLs, return canonical BibTeX cites + cleaned text (RAG-ready corpus).
- extract-structured ($0.0200) - Structured Web Data Extractor: fetch a URL, return JSON matching your schema via a fast LLM. Read-only. Cost ~$0.02.
- pdf-extract ($0.0200) - Extracts text from PDF URLs or base64. Agents lack poppler/pdftotext; we run it server-side.
- ocr ($0.0200) - OCR image to text (Tesseract; url or base64 input). Handles screenshots/scans/photos of text.
- md2pdf ($0.0200) - Markdown to styled PDF document (tables/headings supported). Returns base64 PDF. Non-destructive.
- pdf-invoice ($0.0200) - Generate invoice/receipt PDF from line items (seller, buyer, tax). Returns base64 PDF.
- pdf-merge ($0.0200) - Combine multiple PDFs into one (pass list of base64 PDFs). Contracts, reports, scans.
- exec-python ($0.0200) - Isolated Python 3.12 sandbox: run a snippet with {"payload":...,"input":...} globals, capture stdout + result var. CPU/RAM-capped, no network. Mutating only inside sandbox.
- file-scan ($0.0200) - Static file analysis (nothing executed): sha256 vs MalwareBazaar, YARA rules, entropy, PDF active-content, PE imports/sections, archive entry listing. <=25MB.
- research-brief ($0.0200) - Topic -> search + fetch top sources -> markdown dossier with citations. Research on autopilot.
- link-health ($0.0200) - Crawl a page, report status of every outbound link (broken 4xx/5xx/timeout). Pre-publish link check.
- capture-page ($0.0600) - Full-page screenshot and/or PDF of any URL via headless Chromium. Developers, agents, and users needing clean captures + PDF receipts without running a browser. Returns base64.
- screenshot-mobile ($0.0600) - Mobile-viewport (390x844) screenshot and/or PDF of a URL via headless Chromium. Responsive check without a device.
- site-report ($0.0800) - One-call website security + SSL audit: cert expiry/issuer, missing security headers, load speed. For site owners + devs.
- strip-metadata ($0.1000) - Privacy scrubber: removes EXIF/GPS/comments from images and metadata from PDFs. One call before you post or share.
